attributes.action:
Ban public sales on fireworks 
Make them events only and make them silent!
attributes.additional_details:
The 5th of November is bonfire night not bang night.

This so called one night lasts months no one should be maked to feel unsafe and suffer from people neglecting this one night. No animals domestic or wild should be made to feel unsafe and scared. People moan about us who speak on behalf of those who don't have a voice. We have seen videos of people's home, random people and emergency services people getting attacked by fireworks and still the government do nothing!
attributes.background: We don't need fireworks going off from November all the way till January. Animals and people of all ages shouldn't suffer just for a few seconds of "pretty" colours in the sky. People have been caught on cameras setting them off at random people and emergency services.

rejection.details:
We have two petitions that have opened very recently which call for what your petition is seeking. You may wish to sign them.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349
